skill.name: Database Manager
skill.description: Manages Supabase schemas, migrations, RLS policies, and query patterns for the CookMode V2 application.
skill.summary: Guide CookMode V2 Supabase schema changes, migrations, RLS policies, and database troubleshooting.
skill.author: AdamFehse

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, SQL snippets, JavaScript examples, and descriptive text. One semantic issue remains: the skill repeatedly recommends permissive Supabase RLS policies for all access. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Replace all-access RLS examples with authenticated, role-based, or row ownership policies for production use.
State that permissive policies are only for local or trusted deployments, and require review before deployment.

semantic_findings.title: Overly Permissive RLS Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill documents and templates Supabase policies that allow all users to read and write data. This can expose or corrupt data outside a trusted environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly describes permissive RLS and repeats all-access policy templates. The surrounding note limits this to trusted environments, so the risk is contextual rather than malicious.

content.value_statement: CookMode database changes need consistent schema, migration, RLS, and query guidance. This skill provides Supabase-focused patterns for safe updates and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Documents CookMode V2 Supabase tables and their purposes.
Provides SQL schema examples and migration structure.
Explains current Row Level Security policy patterns.
Shows Supabase client query, upsert, and delete examples.
Lists troubleshooting checks for sync, constraints, and RLS issues.
Highlights real-time subscription tables and related hook locations.
limitations: It is tailored to the CookMode V2 schema and file layout.
It does not connect to Supabase or run migrations by itself.
The included RLS examples need review before production use.
It depends on project files and hooks that may change over time.

use_cases.title: Add a CookMode Feature Table
use_cases.description: Plan a new Supabase table with columns, indexes, migration notes, and application hook updates.

use_cases.title: Review Database Access Rules
use_cases.description: Check current RLS behavior and identify policy changes needed for a safer deployment.

use_cases.title: Debug Real-Time Sync Issues
use_cases.description: Trace schema, policies, subscriptions, and browser errors when CookMode updates stop syncing.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Current Schema
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Database Manager skill to explain the current CookMode V2 Supabase tables and what each table stores.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Migration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Database Manager skill to plan a migration for adding recipe notes to CookMode V2. Include tables, indexes, RLS, and rollback notes.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Sync Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Database Manager skill to debug why ingredient check changes are not syncing across clients. Review subscriptions, RLS, and Supabase errors.

prompt_templates.title: Harden Access Policies
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Database Manager skill to replace permissive CookMode V2 RLS guidance with authenticated policies suitable for a multi-user deployment.

output_examples.input: Add recipe notes to CookMode V2.
output_examples.output: A migration plan covering the new notes table, required fields, indexes, RLS review, rollback notes, and hook updates.

output_examples.input: Ingredient checks stopped syncing between clients.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting checklist covering real-time subscriptions, table policies, Supabase connection state, and browser console errors.

output_examples.input: Prepare the database for a less trusted deployment.
output_examples.output: A policy review that flags all-access RLS rules and recommends authenticated or role-based access boundaries.

best_practices: Review every migration with realistic test data before applying it.
Use least-privilege RLS policies for production and shared environments.
Update application hooks when table structure or access patterns change.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy all-access RLS policies without a trusted environment decision.
Do not drop columns or tables without a tested backup and rollback plan.
Do not change real-time tables without checking subscription and hook behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to Supabase directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. A developer or agent must apply changes through approved project tools.

faq.question: Is permissive RLS production ready?
faq.answer: No. The all-access examples are only suitable for trusted environments and need review before production use.

faq.question: Can it help write migration files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft migration content and rollback notes when the agent has project file access.

faq.question: Which project is this skill built for?
faq.answer: It is built for CookMode V2 and its Supabase PostgreSQL schema.

faq.question: Does it cover real-time subscriptions?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies the tables used for real-time sync and points to the related hook flow.

faq.question: Can it optimize database queries?
faq.answer: It can suggest indexes and query patterns. Validate performance with actual workload data before deployment.
